name: Raspberry 1/3 Stay With Me
original_name: ラズベリー 1/3 Stay With Me
source:
One day main character returns home and sees a pretty girl waiting for his return. She introduces herself as celestial being who needs help in collecting "happy power" from seven girls by having intimacy with them.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
